notes.title: Version 1.3.0.1 - New DLCs coming soon!
notes.notes:
"Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?" is back!

In anticipation of the new DLC question packs (coming soon!), we've updated the following features:

• Thanks to your help, we've fixed several errors that appeared in the answers to the questions in the original game
• It is now possible to select just 1 question pack to play (instead of the previous minimum of 4) 
• Multiplayer lobbies have been reduced from 100 to 50 players to facilitate their creation. 

Thank you for your loyalty and staunch support!

Already available: 

Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? - Season Pass
Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - US Movies 90s DLC Pack
